A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LS-Imagine paper, including complete Appendices A–D. Their text, equations, figures and tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original MineDojo experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations and long-horizon Tech Tree results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and results, including Table 3, the ablations and the Tech Tree comparison.

M1.justification: The affordance generator, intrinsic reward, long short-term world model and actor-critic procedure are unchanged. Removing the redundant word 'final' from the decoder description in Appendix C.2 does not change its architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same five main MineDojo tasks, seven-subgoal Tech Tree task and invisible or occluded target examples in Appendix D.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains VPT, STEVE-1, PTGM, Director and DreamerV3 as comparators. Figure 14 retains the same DreamerV3 comparison for the Tech Tree task.

E3.justification: Section 4, Table 2 and Appendix D.5 retain the same observation resolution, training budgets, episode limits and evaluation metrics. No evaluation procedure or setting is revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations, series-versus-parallel comparison, jumping-frequency and interval analyses, occlusion examples and hyperparameter sensitivity analyses are all retained without changes.

E5.justification: The plotted uncertainty bands and error bars are unchanged. Neither version supplies explicit experimental seed or repeated-run counts, and v3 adds no uncertainty-estimation procedure or significance test.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted curves and qualitative examples match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 reports the same 80.63% harvest-log success rate for LS-Imagine in both versions.

T1.justification: The POMDP formulation, affordance and jumping definitions, model losses and modified lambda-return equations are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about extending imagination horizons, improving exploration and outperforming existing MineDojo agents.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability limits are unchanged, including computational overhead, dependence on embodied 3D environments and possible failures in situations unfamiliar to MineCLIP.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training time and code-access information are unchanged. The corrected citation in Appendix C.2 does not identify a different encoder or disclose a new implementation setting.

R1.justification: Appendix C.2 corrects MineCLIP's text-encoder attribution from Cao et al. (2022), the Swin-Unet reference, to Fan et al. (2022), the MineDojo reference. Both works were already cited; related-work coverage and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Appendix C.2 corrects the citation and changes 'Finally, a final patch expanding layer' to 'Finally, a patch expanding layer.' The arXiv version/date stamp is updated, while section organization and the remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–16, Tables 1–4 and Algorithm 1 retain their content, structure, captions and placement. Local prose rewrapping and the updated arXiv stamp do not alter the displays or page organization.

improvement.justification: v3 fixes a misleading MineCLIP attribution in Appendix C.2 and removes redundant wording. This provides a small editorial quality improvement; the scientific method, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged.
